newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH LAHIVAKUUTUS 96 PREMIUM INCOME GROWS 6 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH LAHIVAKUUTUS 96 PREMIUM INCOME GROWS 6 PCT.

text.p: Finnish mutual insurance group Lahivakuutus-ryhma said on Wednesday its non-life premium income before re-insurance grew six percent to 742 million markka in 1996 from the year before.
"The group's premium income before re-insurance increased six percent, compared to the average two percent growth in Finnish non-life premium income," Lahivakuutus said in a statement.
The group's operating profit at 56 million markka was over 15 percent of turnover, it said but gave no comparison.
The group paid a total of 480 million markka in non-life claims and the claims ratio was 69 percent.
Net investment income was 58 million markka, it said.
"Due to the good result, the solvency ratio improved further and is close to 200 percent," Lahivakuutus said.
